program.title: Web Development
program.description: Build modern websites and web applications from the ground up. You will learn semantic HTML, responsive CSS, JavaScript, React, and how to ship accessible interfaces that work across devices and browsers.

liveSession.title: Responsive Layouts with CSS Grid & Flexbox

courses.title: HTML & CSS Foundations
courses.description: Learn how to structure content with semantic HTML and style it with modern CSS. This live class focuses on layout systems, responsive breakpoints, and building a multi-section landing page you can add to your portfolio.
courses.overview: You will cover document structure, accessibility basics, the box model, Flexbox, and CSS Grid. By the end of the session you should be able to explain when to use each layout tool and implement a mobile-first responsive page from a simple wireframe.
courses.recordingSummary: Recording will be available after this live session ends.

courses.title: JavaScript & the DOM
courses.description: A completed module on JavaScript fundamentals and browser APIs. You explored variables, functions, events, and how to manipulate the DOM to build interactive pages without a framework.
courses.overview: This class introduces core JavaScript syntax, control flow, arrays and objects, and DOM selection and updates. You also practiced debugging in DevTools and writing small features such as form validation and toggle menus.
courses.recordingSummary: Rewatch the session to review live coding demos, event handling patterns, and the Q&A on async basics and fetch introductions.

courses.title: React & Component Design
courses.description: Upcoming live class on React components, props, state, and composition. You will refactor a static page into reusable components and manage UI state for a simple dashboard widget.
courses.overview: Students learn how React models UI as a function of state, when to lift state up, and how to structure folders for small apps. Topics include JSX, lists and keys, conditional rendering, and basic hooks with useState.
courses.recordingSummary: Recording will appear here after the session is completed.

courses.title: APIs, Auth & Deployment
courses.description: Upcoming session on consuming REST APIs, handling loading and error states in the UI, and deploying a static or Next.js app to a hosting platform with environment variables and basic auth flows.
courses.overview: You will connect a front-end to sample API endpoints, discuss CORS and tokens at a high level, and walk through a deployment checklist. The goal is to ship a small project that fetches data and runs in production.
courses.recordingSummary: Recording will appear here after the session is completed.
